purpose: Non-performance accounting-contract corrections after static implementation review; no strategy parameter search or market outcome used.

original_contract.preservation: Exact current initial bytes were hashed, copied without overwrite and rehashed before amendments.

amendments.reason: Initial prose could imply reserving the exit commission twice.
amendments.change: max_debit includes notional, entry commission and exit commission reserve. The future exit reserve is not added again to that pending cap.

amendments.reason: A timestamp acquired before an intent transaction commits does not establish the quote occurred after durable intent.
amendments.change: Require a readiness marker in a subsequent transaction and quote source time strictly after its timestamp; unfinished readiness remains unfillable. Refuse previously observed source-payload hash reuse as newly observed bytes.

amendments.reason: The bounded implementation raises on invalid fill attempts without appending a general refusal event. Initial prose requested a broader attempt audit than implemented.
amendments.change: Explicitly state fill/malformed-input refusals are not persisted, preserve zero accounting mutation, and retain a reviewed attempt-log activation blocker. An attributable newer bad-quality quote is durably recorded and invalidates an older good mark; impossible source envelopes may fail without an event.

amendments.reason: The first implementation exposed a last-tradable cutoff without the separate expiration date required by the contract. The engine owner elected to add the date rather than narrow the contract.
amendments.change: Clarify expiration date must be no earlier than the UTC date of last_tradable_at. Both remain supplied assertions, with calendar and exercise lifecycle unimplemented.

amendments.reason: Static review identified a bounded limitation: the implementation refuses a disposal whose modeled net proceeds are zero or negative even when other cash could fund the fee.
amendments.change: Disclose that the position stays held and the mark remains unknown; do not claim a complete liquidation mechanism.

review_scope.method: Read the initial complete engine and CLI and coordinate contract consistency with implementer and independent test reviewer.
review_scope.implementation_validation: Separate final code review and test receipt required; this record is not an implementation pass.
